registry.note: No dedicated artifact registry is registered. The read-only OCI-v2 probe can rehash a registered manifest/config and bind the source revision; it never substitutes GitHub ZIP artifact metadata or a tag for OCI digest/signing/provenance. Reader/push refs remain declarations, not runtime authority.

artifactIdentity.tagBinding: A tag must resolve to exactly one immutable digest; a tag repointed to a different digest blocks candidate promotion (TAG_DIGEST_DRIFT).
artifactIdentity.buildBinding: An artifact digest must be built from the integration merge SHA of the candidate (ARTIFACT_NOT_FROM_MERGE otherwise).
